title: SB1343 (113th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 39, Chapter 17, Part 13, relative to firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2023-01-31; crossfiled twin's official copy via the Internet Archive snapshot 20260514153429 of https://www.capitol.tn.gov/Bills/113/Bill/HB1466.pdf (it names SENATE BILL 1343; own link https://www.capitol.tn.gov/Bills/113/Bill/SB1343.pdf not archived))
provenance.note: Draft as filed (2023-01-31), read from the House twin HB 1466 document that names SB 1343. Section 1 replaces the whole subsection (c); the veteran/service-member clause lowers 'minor' to under 18 for them. The state summary also mentions a sale/loan/gift offense, which is not in the text read beyond the redefinition.

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1303(c)): For purposes of this section: (1) "Intoxicated" means substantial impairment of mental or physical capacity resulting from introduction of any substance into the body; and (2) "Minor" means a person less than twenty-one (21) years of age;
SECTION 2 (TCA 39-17-1303(d)): A minor is prohibited from purchasing or owning a firearm and commits an offense if the minor purchases or owns a firearm.
